hook: Your MacBook notch, turned into a dashboard

beats.say: ILoveNotch is a free, open-source app that turns the MacBook notch into a hub, in ten themes.

It shows now playing, a file shelf, calendar, Reminders, notes, timers and per-app volume, plus your Claude, Codex, Cursor and Copilot usage. You can keep an eye on your AI coding limits without leaving what you are doing.
Version 2.0 adds a teleprompter. It is native SwiftUI with near-zero idle CPU.
